description: The first CLI for Shopper — every catalog, cart, and delivery surface plus a local price/basket history the web app throws away each cycle.

tools.name: address_list_address
tools.description: List the saved delivery addresses for the authenticated Shopper account. Takes no parameters; results are scoped to the bearer token. Returns the address book (each entry with its id, label, and location fields). Call this to discover which address a delivery or cart is bound to before scheduling or rescheduling.

tools.name: cart_add
tools.description: Add a product to the cart or increase its quantity. Required: id, quantity. Optional: engine. Returns the new cart.

tools.name: cart_list_summary
tools.description: Fetch the current cart summary for the authenticated account: line items, quantities, and totals as the store computes them. Takes no parameters; the cart is keyed off the bearer token. Use this to read cart state after cart_add/cart_remove, or before checkout — it reflects the server-side cart, not a local copy. Returns the summary.

tools.name: cart_remove
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart or decrease its quantity. Required: id, quantity. Returns the new cart.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Quantity to remove (decrements; full qty removes the line)

tools.name: catalog_create_count
tools.description: POST /catalog/search/count. Required: brands, metadata, types. Optional: query. Returns the new count.

tools.name: catalog_create_filters
tools.description: POST /catalog/search/filters. Required: brands, metadata, types. Optional: query. Returns the new filters.

tools.name: catalog_create_search
tools.description: POST /catalog/search. Required: brands, metadata, types. Optional: page, query, size. Returns the new search.

tools.name: catalog_get_view
tools.description: GET /catalog/banners/{banner_id}/view. Required: banner_id. Returns the view.

tools.name: catalog_list_banners
tools.description: GET /catalog/banners. Optional: imageSize. Returns the banners.

tools.name: catalog_list_departments
tools.description: List the Shopper catalog's top-level departments (the store's category tree used for browsing). Takes no parameters. Returns each department with its id and name. Use this to map a free-text department name to the id needed when filtering catalog search.

tools.name: catalog_list_news
tools.description: List newly added products in the Shopper catalog (the store's 'what's new' feed). Takes no parameters. Returns recently introduced products with id, name, and price. Prefer this over catalog_search when you want recent arrivals rather than a keyword query.

tools.name: catalog_list_suggest
tools.description: GET /catalog/search/suggest. Optional: query. Returns the suggest.

tools.name: delivery_list_calendar
tools.description: Fetch the delivery reschedule calendar from /delivery/v2/calendar: the date-picker configuration the store uses, i.e. the allowed reschedule date range and the set of disabled (unavailable) days. Takes no parameters; scoped to the account's active order. Use this to find which dates a delivery may be moved to before calling a reschedule; pair with delivery_list_summary to see the currently scheduled date. Returns the calendar.

tools.name: delivery_list_summary
tools.description: Fetch the current delivery summary from /delivery/summary: the scheduled delivery date and related order-timing fields (charge and cutoff/lock dates the store derives from it) for the authenticated account. Takes no parameters. Use this to see when the next basket is scheduled to arrive; pair with delivery_list_calendar for the dates it can be moved to. Returns the summary.

tools.name: features_create_select
tools.description: POST /features/stores/select. Required: store_id. Returns the new select.

tools.name: features_create_start
tools.description: POST /features/timer/start. Required: name. Returns the new start.

tools.name: features_create_view
tools.description: POST /features/toggle/view. Required: toggle. Returns the new view.

tools.name: features_list_stores
tools.description: GET /features/stores. Optional: toggles. Returns the stores.

tools.name: features_list_tick
tools.description: Read the current server timer tick from /features/timer/tick — the countdown/clock value the store uses to gate time-bound flows such as the order edit/cutoff window. Takes no parameters. Returns the current tick state. Use this to check how much time remains before the cart locks rather than computing it client-side.

tools.name: features_list_toggle
tools.description: Read the active feature flags (toggles) for the authenticated session from /features/toggle. Takes no parameters. Returns the set of enabled feature flags. Use this to detect which store capabilities are available to this account before invoking a feature-gated command.

tools.name: session_list_social
tools.description: Validate the current social-login session via /auth/validation/social. Takes no parameters; validates the bearer token's social-auth state. Returns the session/social validation result. Use this to confirm the configured token is still authenticated before running account-scoped commands.
